name: Social Content Generation Pipeline
description: Sohamyoga content agent: takes a topic + platform, calls Ollama llama3.2, adapts the output for the target platform, then returns the finished post.

nodes.label: Topic Input
nodes.description: Enter the topic or theme for the social post

config.placeholder: e.g. Morning yoga routine for beginners

nodes.label: Platform Selector
nodes.description: Choose the target social media platform

nodes.label: Content Prompt Builder
nodes.description: Combines topic, platform, and tone into a structured prompt for Ollama

config.template:
You are a social media content expert for a yoga and wellness brand.

Write a {tone_value} {platform_name} post about: {topic_text}

Platform requirements:
- instagram: 5-10 hashtags, visual storytelling, under 2200 chars
- twitter/x: 1-2 hashtags, under 280 chars
- linkedin: professional tone, 1-3 hashtags, under 3000 chars
- facebook: conversational, under 1000 chars
- youtube: description format with keywords, under 5000 chars
- tiktok: punchy, trend-aware, under 150 chars
- pinterest: descriptive, keyword-rich, under 500 chars

Return ONLY the post text — no explanation, no labels.

nodes.label: Ollama Content Generator (llama3.2)
nodes.description: Calls local Ollama llama3.2 to generate the initial post content

nodes.label: Platform Adaptation Prompt
nodes.description: Asks Ollama to review and trim the content to match platform limits exactly

config.template:
Review this {platform_name} post and ensure it strictly meets platform requirements (character limits, hashtag count, tone). Make minimal changes — only what is needed to comply.

Post:
{raw_content}

Return ONLY the final post text.

nodes.label: Ollama Platform Adapter (llama3.2)
nodes.description: Second Ollama pass to enforce platform-specific constraints

nodes.label: Final Post Output
nodes.description: The finished, platform-ready social media post

metadata.author: sohamyoga-ai-platform
metadata.import_instructions: In LangFlow UI: click Import Flow, select this file. Ollama must be running at http://localhost:11434 with llama3.2 pulled.
